22use super::{Version, VersionRef};

24/**
25 * @author bbrown@google.com (Brian Brown)
26 */
27pub struct BitMatrixParser {
28    mappingBitMatrix: BitMatrix,
29    readMappingMatrix: BitMatrix,
30    version: VersionRef,
31}
32impl BitMatrixParser {
33    /**
34     * @param bitMatrix {@link BitMatrix} to parse
35     * @throws FormatException if dimension is < 8 or > 144 or not 0 mod 2
36     */
37    pub fn new(bitMatrix: &BitMatrix) -> Result<Self> {
38        let dimension = bitMatrix.getHeight();
39        if !(8..=144).contains(&dimension) || (dimension & 0x01) != 0 {
40            return Err(Exceptions::FORMAT);
41        }
42
43        let version = Self::readVersion(bitMatrix)?;
44        let mappingBitMatrix = Self::extractDataRegion(bitMatrix, version)?;
45        let readMappingMatrix =
46            BitMatrix::new(mappingBitMatrix.getWidth(), mappingBitMatrix.getHeight())?;
47
48        Ok(Self {
49            mappingBitMatrix,
50            readMappingMatrix,
51            version,
52        })
53    }
54
55    pub fn getVersion(&self) -> &Version {
56        self.version
57    }
58
59    /**
60     * <p>Creates the version object based on the dimension of the original bit matrix from
61     * the datamatrix code.</p>
62     *
63     * <p>See ISO 16022:2006 Table 7 - ECC 200 symbol attributes</p>
64     *
65     * @param bitMatrix Original {@link BitMatrix} including alignment patterns
66     * @return {@link Version} encapsulating the Data Matrix Code's "version"
67     * @throws FormatException if the dimensions of the mapping matrix are not valid
68     * Data Matrix dimensions.
69     */
70    fn readVersion(bitMatrix: &BitMatrix) -> Result<VersionRef> {
71        let numRows = bitMatrix.getHeight();
72        let numColumns = bitMatrix.getWidth();
73        Version::getVersionForDimensions(numRows, numColumns)
74    }
75
76    /**
77     * <p>Reads the bits in the {@link BitMatrix} representing the mapping matrix (No alignment patterns)
78     * in the correct order in order to reconstitute the codewords bytes contained within the
79     * Data Matrix Code.</p>
80     *
81     * @return bytes encoded within the Data Matrix Code
82     * @throws FormatException if the exact number of bytes expected is not read
83     */
84    pub fn readCodewords(&mut self) -> Result<Vec<u8>> {
85        let mut result = vec![0u8; self.version.getTotalCodewords() as usize];
86        let mut resultOffset = 0;
87
88        let mut row = 4;
89        let mut column = 0;
90
91        let numRows = self.mappingBitMatrix.getHeight() as isize;
92        let numColumns = self.mappingBitMatrix.getWidth() as isize;
93
94        let mut corner1Read = false;
95        let mut corner2Read = false;
96        let mut corner3Read = false;
97        let mut corner4Read = false;
98
99        // Read all of the codewords
100        loop {
101            // Check the four corner cases
102            if (row == numRows) && (column == 0) && !corner1Read {
103                result[resultOffset] = self.readCorner1(numRows, numColumns) as u8;
104                resultOffset += 1;
105                row -= 2;
106                column += 2;
107                corner1Read = true;
108            } else if (row == numRows - 2)
109                && (column == 0)
110                && ((numColumns & 0x03) != 0)
111                && !corner2Read
112            {
113                result[resultOffset] = self.readCorner2(numRows, numColumns) as u8;
114                resultOffset += 1;
115                row -= 2;
116                column += 2;
117                corner2Read = true;
118            } else if (row == numRows + 4)
119                && (column == 2)
120                && ((numColumns & 0x07) == 0)
121                && !corner3Read
122            {
123                result[resultOffset] = self.readCorner3(numRows, numColumns) as u8;
124                resultOffset += 1;
125                row -= 2;
126                column += 2;
127                corner3Read = true;
128            } else if (row == numRows - 2)
129                && (column == 0)
130                && ((numColumns & 0x07) == 4)
131                && !corner4Read
132            {
133                result[resultOffset] = self.readCorner4(numRows, numColumns) as u8;
134                resultOffset += 1;
135                row -= 2;
136                column += 2;
137                corner4Read = true;
138            } else {
139                // Sweep upward diagonally to the right
140                loop {
141                    if (row < numRows)
142                        && (column >= 0)
143                        && !self.readMappingMatrix.get(column as u32, row as u32)
144                    {
145                        result[resultOffset] =
146                            self.readUtah(row, column, numRows, numColumns) as u8;
147                        resultOffset += 1;
148                    }
149                    row -= 2;
150                    column += 2;
151                    if !((row >= 0) && (column < numColumns)) {
152                        break;
153                    }
154                }
155                row += 1;
156                column += 3;
157
158                // Sweep downward diagonally to the left
159                loop {
160                    if (row >= 0)
161                        && (column < numColumns)
162                        && !self.readMappingMatrix.get(column as u32, row as u32)
163                    {
164                        result[resultOffset] =
165                            self.readUtah(row, column, numRows, numColumns) as u8;
166                        resultOffset += 1;
167                    }
168                    row += 2;
169                    column -= 2;
170
171                    if !((row < numRows) && (column >= 0)) {
172                        break;
173                    }
174                }
175                row += 3;
176                column += 1;
177            }
178            if !((row < numRows) || (column < numColumns)) {
179                break;
180            }
181        }
182
183        if resultOffset != self.version.getTotalCodewords() as usize {
184            return Err(Exceptions::FORMAT);
185        }
186
187        Ok(result)
188    }
189
190    /**
191     * <p>Reads a bit of the mapping matrix accounting for boundary wrapping.</p>
192     *
193     * @param row Row to read in the mapping matrix
194     * @param column Column to read in the mapping matrix
195     * @param numRows Number of rows in the mapping matrix
196     * @param numColumns Number of columns in the mapping matrix
197     * @return value of the given bit in the mapping matrix
198     */
199    fn readModule(&mut self, row: isize, column: isize, numRows: isize, numColumns: isize) -> bool {
200        let mut row = row;
201        let mut column = column;
202        // Adjust the row and column indices based on boundary wrapping
203        if row < 0 {
204            row += numRows;
205            column += 4 - ((numRows + 4) & 0x07);
206        }
207        if column < 0 {
208            column += numColumns;
209            row += 4 - ((numColumns + 4) & 0x07);
210        }
211        if row >= numRows {
212            row -= numRows;
213        }
214        self.readMappingMatrix.set(column as u32, row as u32);
215
216        self.mappingBitMatrix.get(column as u32, row as u32)
217    }
218
219    /**
220     * <p>Reads the 8 bits of the standard Utah-shaped pattern.</p>
221     *
222     * <p>See ISO 16022:2006, 5.8.1 Figure 6</p>
223     *
224     * @param row Current row in the mapping matrix, anchored at the 8th bit (LSB) of the pattern
225     * @param column Current column in the mapping matrix, anchored at the 8th bit (LSB) of the pattern
226     * @param numRows Number of rows in the mapping matrix
227     * @param numColumns Number of columns in the mapping matrix
228     * @return byte from the utah shape
229     */
230    fn readUtah(&mut self, row: isize, column: isize, numRows: isize, numColumns: isize) -> u32 {
231        let mut currentByte = 0;
232        if self.readModule(row - 2, column - 2, numRows, numColumns) {
233            currentByte |= 1;
234        }
235        currentByte <<= 1;
236        if self.readModule(row - 2, column - 1, numRows, numColumns) {
237            currentByte |= 1;
238        }
239        currentByte <<= 1;
240        if self.readModule(row - 1, column - 2, numRows, numColumns) {
241            currentByte |= 1;
242        }
243        currentByte <<= 1;
244        if self.readModule(row - 1, column - 1, numRows, numColumns) {
245            currentByte |= 1;
246        }
247        currentByte <<= 1;
248        if self.readModule(row - 1, column, numRows, numColumns) {
249            currentByte |= 1;
250        }
251        currentByte <<= 1;
252        if self.readModule(row, column - 2, numRows, numColumns) {
253            currentByte |= 1;
254        }
255        currentByte <<= 1;
256        if self.readModule(row, column - 1, numRows, numColumns) {
257            currentByte |= 1;
258        }
259        currentByte <<= 1;
260        if self.readModule(row, column, numRows, numColumns) {
261            currentByte |= 1;
262        }
263        currentByte
264    }
265
266    /**
267     * <p>Reads the 8 bits of the special corner condition 1.</p>
268     *
269     * <p>See ISO 16022:2006, Figure F.3</p>
270     *
271     * @param numRows Number of rows in the mapping matrix
272     * @param numColumns Number of columns in the mapping matrix
273     * @return byte from the Corner condition 1
274     */
275    fn readCorner1(&mut self, numRows: isize, numColumns: isize) -> u32 {
276        let mut currentByte = 0;
277        if self.readModule(numRows - 1, 0, numRows, numColumns) {
278            currentByte |= 1;
279        }
280        currentByte <<= 1;
281        if self.readModule(numRows - 1, 1, numRows, numColumns) {
282            currentByte |= 1;
283        }
284        currentByte <<= 1;
285        if self.readModule(numRows - 1, 2, numRows, numColumns) {
286            currentByte |= 1;
287        }
288        currentByte <<= 1;
289        if self.readModule(0, numColumns - 2, numRows, numColumns) {
290            currentByte |= 1;
291        }
292        currentByte <<= 1;
293        if self.readModule(0, numColumns - 1, numRows, numColumns) {
294            currentByte |= 1;
295        }
296        currentByte <<= 1;
297        if self.readModule(1, numColumns - 1, numRows, numColumns) {
298            currentByte |= 1;
299        }
300        currentByte <<= 1;
301        if self.readModule(2, numColumns - 1, numRows, numColumns) {
302            currentByte |= 1;
303        }
304        currentByte <<= 1;
305        if self.readModule(3, numColumns - 1, numRows, numColumns) {
306            currentByte |= 1;
307        }
308        currentByte
309    }

311    /**
312     * <p>Reads the 8 bits of the special corner condition 2.</p>
313     *
314     * <p>See ISO 16022:2006, Figure F.4</p>
315     *
316     * @param numRows Number of rows in the mapping matrix
317     * @param numColumns Number of columns in the mapping matrix
318     * @return byte from the Corner condition 2
319     */
320    fn readCorner2(&mut self, numRows: isize, numColumns: isize) -> u32 {
321        let mut currentByte = 0;
322        if self.readModule(numRows - 3, 0, numRows, numColumns) {
323            currentByte |= 1;
324        }
325        currentByte <<= 1;
326        if self.readModule(numRows - 2, 0, numRows, numColumns) {
327            currentByte |= 1;
328        }
329        currentByte <<= 1;
330        if self.readModule(numRows - 1, 0, numRows, numColumns) {
331            currentByte |= 1;
332        }
333        currentByte <<= 1;
334        if self.readModule(0, numColumns - 4, numRows, numColumns) {
335            currentByte |= 1;
336        }
337        currentByte <<= 1;
338        if self.readModule(0, numColumns - 3, numRows, numColumns) {
339            currentByte |= 1;
340        }
341        currentByte <<= 1;
342        if self.readModule(0, numColumns - 2, numRows, numColumns) {
343            currentByte |= 1;
344        }
345        currentByte <<= 1;
346        if self.readModule(0, numColumns - 1, numRows, numColumns) {
347            currentByte |= 1;
348        }
349        currentByte <<= 1;
350        if self.readModule(1, numColumns - 1, numRows, numColumns) {
351            currentByte |= 1;
352        }
353        currentByte
354    }

356    /**
357     * <p>Reads the 8 bits of the special corner condition 3.</p>
358     *
359     * <p>See ISO 16022:2006, Figure F.5</p>
360     *
361     * @param numRows Number of rows in the mapping matrix
362     * @param numColumns Number of columns in the mapping matrix
363     * @return byte from the Corner condition 3
364     */
365    fn readCorner3(&mut self, numRows: isize, numColumns: isize) -> u32 {
366        let mut currentByte = 0;
367        if self.readModule(numRows - 1, 0, numRows, numColumns) {
368            currentByte |= 1;
369        }
370        currentByte <<= 1;
371        if self.readModule(numRows - 1, numColumns - 1, numRows, numColumns) {
372            currentByte |= 1;
373        }
374        currentByte <<= 1;
375        if self.readModule(0, numColumns - 3, numRows, numColumns) {
376            currentByte |= 1;
377        }
378        currentByte <<= 1;
379        if self.readModule(0, numColumns - 2, numRows, numColumns) {
380            currentByte |= 1;
381        }
382        currentByte <<= 1;
383        if self.readModule(0, numColumns - 1, numRows, numColumns) {
384            currentByte |= 1;
385        }
386        currentByte <<= 1;
387        if self.readModule(1, numColumns - 3, numRows, numColumns) {
388            currentByte |= 1;
389        }
390        currentByte <<= 1;
391        if self.readModule(1, numColumns - 2, numRows, numColumns) {
392            currentByte |= 1;
393        }
394        currentByte <<= 1;
395        if self.readModule(1, numColumns - 1, numRows, numColumns) {
396            currentByte |= 1;
397        }
398        currentByte
399    }

401    /**
402     * <p>Reads the 8 bits of the special corner condition 4.</p>
403     *
404     * <p>See ISO 16022:2006, Figure F.6</p>
405     *
406     * @param numRows Number of rows in the mapping matrix
407     * @param numColumns Number of columns in the mapping matrix
408     * @return byte from the Corner condition 4
409     */
410    fn readCorner4(&mut self, numRows: isize, numColumns: isize) -> u32 {
411        let mut currentByte = 0;
412        if self.readModule(numRows - 3, 0, numRows, numColumns) {
413            currentByte |= 1;
414        }
415        currentByte <<= 1;
416        if self.readModule(numRows - 2, 0, numRows, numColumns) {
417            currentByte |= 1;
418        }
419        currentByte <<= 1;
420        if self.readModule(numRows - 1, 0, numRows, numColumns) {
421            currentByte |= 1;
422        }
423        currentByte <<= 1;
424        if self.readModule(0, numColumns - 2, numRows, numColumns) {
425            currentByte |= 1;
426        }
427        currentByte <<= 1;
428        if self.readModule(0, numColumns - 1, numRows, numColumns) {
429            currentByte |= 1;
430        }
431        currentByte <<= 1;
432        if self.readModule(1, numColumns - 1, numRows, numColumns) {
433            currentByte |= 1;
434        }
435        currentByte <<= 1;
436        if self.readModule(2, numColumns - 1, numRows, numColumns) {
437            currentByte |= 1;
438        }
439        currentByte <<= 1;
440        if self.readModule(3, numColumns - 1, numRows, numColumns) {
441            currentByte |= 1;
442        }
443        currentByte
444    }

446    /**
447     * <p>Extracts the data region from a {@link BitMatrix} that contains
448     * alignment patterns.</p>
449     *
450     * @param bitMatrix Original {@link BitMatrix} with alignment patterns
451     * @return BitMatrix that has the alignment patterns removed
452     */
453    fn extractDataRegion(bitMatrix: &BitMatrix, version: VersionRef) -> Result<BitMatrix> {
454        // dbg!(bitMatrix.to_string());
455        let symbolSizeRows = version.getSymbolSizeRows();
456        let symbolSizeColumns = version.getSymbolSizeColumns();
457
458        if bitMatrix.getHeight() != symbolSizeRows {
459            return Err(Exceptions::illegal_argument_with(
460                "Dimension of bitMatrix must match the version size",
461            ));
462        }
463
464        let dataRegionSizeRows = version.getDataRegionSizeRows();
465        let dataRegionSizeColumns = version.getDataRegionSizeColumns();
466
467        let numDataRegionsRow = symbolSizeRows / dataRegionSizeRows;
468        let numDataRegionsColumn = symbolSizeColumns / dataRegionSizeColumns;
469
470        let sizeDataRegionRow = numDataRegionsRow * dataRegionSizeRows;
471        let sizeDataRegionColumn = numDataRegionsColumn * dataRegionSizeColumns;
472
473        let mut bitMatrixWithoutAlignment =
474            BitMatrix::new(sizeDataRegionColumn, sizeDataRegionRow)?;
475        for dataRegionRow in 0..numDataRegionsRow {
476            // for (int dataRegionRow = 0; dataRegionRow < numDataRegionsRow; ++dataRegionRow) {
477            let dataRegionRowOffset = dataRegionRow * dataRegionSizeRows;
478            for dataRegionColumn in 0..numDataRegionsColumn {
479                // for (int dataRegionColumn = 0; dataRegionColumn < numDataRegionsColumn; ++dataRegionColumn) {
480                let dataRegionColumnOffset = dataRegionColumn * dataRegionSizeColumns;
481                for i in 0..dataRegionSizeRows {
482                    // for (int i = 0; i < dataRegionSizeRows; ++i) {
483                    let readRowOffset = dataRegionRow * (dataRegionSizeRows + 2) + 1 + i;
484                    let writeRowOffset = dataRegionRowOffset + i;
485                    for j in 0..dataRegionSizeColumns {
486                        // for (int j = 0; j < dataRegionSizeColumns; ++j) {
487                        let readColumnOffset =
488                            dataRegionColumn * (dataRegionSizeColumns + 2) + 1 + j;
489                        if bitMatrix.get(readColumnOffset, readRowOffset) {
490                            let writeColumnOffset = dataRegionColumnOffset + j;
491                            bitMatrixWithoutAlignment.set(writeColumnOffset, writeRowOffset);
492                        }
493                    }
494                }
495            }
496        }
497        Ok(bitMatrixWithoutAlignment)
498    }
